purpose: decide whether GigaHands bad views come from the dataset's own annotation or from our loader/indexing of RGB, 2D, 3D, chosen_frames and cameras

official_source_consulted.what_it_shows: reads chosen_frames_left.json / chosen_frames_right.json as SETS of frame ids, returns their union and intersection, then indexes MANO parameters by [chosen_hand_union_frames.index(f) for f in chosen_video_frames] - i.e. params are indexed by POSITION IN THE UNION, not by frame id
official_source_consulted.annotation_pipeline: 2D keypoints from HaMeR; left/right assignment via ViTPose

mapping_rules_verified.M1: keypoints_2d row index == RGB video frame index
mapping_rules_verified.M2: keypoints_3d row index == RGB video frame index (rows 0..max(chosen))
mapping_rules_verified.M3: params / repro_2d_vid / repro_3d_vid / mano_vid use union position
mapping_rules_verified.M4: chosen_frames_<hand> = frame ids with a valid 3D pose for that hand

diagnostic_bands.note: same bands as CAM-EXP-001.1 for comparability; NOT the final quality gate, which is decided in CAM-EXP-001.3

hand_swap_criterion: annotation centroid closer to the other hand's projection AND within 60 px of it; centroids are used because left and right skeletons have mirrored joint ordering

loader_change.change: added drop_zero_2d (default True) and is_zero_2d(); documented index conventions and the video-matching rule
loader_change.note: CAM-EXP-001 raw outputs are NOT regenerated or overwritten
